text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, Gold City was
being interviewed for a magazine—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—What I'm into lately?
Come to think of it, I recently started yoga.
I happened to meet a wonderful instructor.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see, as expected of City-san, you really pay close attention to your body shaping!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah... it's more for relaxing and working on core muscles, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, with that much training,
there's hardly any time to gain weight!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha... Well, that might be true.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That was close. Saying I'm dieting
with yoga would be way too embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Trainer!? Did you hear that just now?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I go out with Jordan and the others,
I just end up getting caught up in the vibe and eating way too much."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, geez, this is so embarrassing. I'll lose it right away, so don't tell anyone I'm on a diet, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, perhaps thanks to the yoga, Gold City
successfully regained her original figure.
